description: Department of Labour, Labour Standards Division - Special Allowance Payble to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade in the month of April 2017 will be paid as 687.51
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payment for workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically addressing service conditions and benefits for workers, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The notification is issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance and comes from the Department of Labour, making it a public service administrative matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any of the other specialized categories.
